releaseNotes: v1.10.0: Env-configurable retention for SQLite and logs. Prunes requestDetails by age (72h) and row cap (20k), usageHistory by age (720h), keeps the DB under RETENTION_DB_MAX_MB (256) via incremental vacuum, and tail-truncates RETENTION_LOG_FILES above RETENTION_LOG_MAX_MB (16). Disable with RETENTION_ENABLED=false.
